name: OpenClaw
writeNote: the file is JSON5 (unquoted keys, single quotes), which tk does not parse; paste the fragment, or use `openclaw mcp set <name> '<json>'`. OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH, OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR and OPENCLAW_HOME move the file, and OPENCLAW_CONFIG_READONLY=1 makes it read-only
nameMangling: characters outside [A-Za-z0-9_-] become -; a fragment must start with a letter or gets mcp- or tool-; server part capped at 30, total at 64; collisions get -2, -3 (V, src/agents/agent-bundle-mcp-names.ts)
notes: A url with no transport resolves to SSE (V, src/agents/mcp-transport-config.ts#L138), so tk names transport streamable-http explicitly. command wins over url. ${VAR} and ${VAR:-default}; a missing variable is an error (V, src/config/env-substitution.ts). Writes strip JSON5 comments with a warning (V). `__proto__` is a reserved server name.
sources: github.com/openclaw/openclaw at v2026.10.8: src/config/paths.ts, src/agents/mcp-transport-config.ts, src/config/env-substitution.ts, src/cli/mcp-cli.ts#L948-L1010, docs/tools/mcp.md, docs/cli/mcp/transports.md (lane C research, 27 Oct 2026)

coverage.note: fail-closed hook runner (read); tk runs last and hands back the params it checked (run); exec is gated as bash, but Code Mode's exec is a code tool and is not aliased; MCP tools reach it as <server>__<tool>; not in Orca's grid; needs Node 24.22.1 or later (lane I, applied by integration w2)
